explication: SonarQube MCP Server exposes SonarQube Server and Cloud capabilities to AI-agent MCP clients, including SonarQube-backed code analysis, quality/security queries, architecture tools, and agentic-readiness assessments. The principal workflow is an agent tool request, dispatch to a domain tool, and a SonarQube API request whose result is returned through MCP. It also supports OAuth-protected HTTP use, IDE-backed analysis, and proxied MCP servers. Several domain branches are identified from the repository tree; their internal call wiring was not sampled, so uncertain links are omitted.
